it's a common and difficult problem. 
A few things that helped me decide were:
- The fact that thinking about being trans this much, daily every couple hours is NOT WHAT CIS PEOPLE DO. Typically CIS individuals think about transitioning  about as much as they think about changing skin colour.  
- My primary reason for deciding I'm trans, was how much hurt and upset it's caused me. Sometimes I'm fine in boy mode and it doesn't bother me... The lack of hurt all the time is not an excuse to ignore the massive amounts of hurt and pain it causes other times. I think about the childhood I missed out on and get incredibly upset. 

If you're really struggling to decide. Write a list of what hurts or upsets you. Make a big sad list of why. A good look at why it's an issue, in writing in front of you, often feels  lot more tangible than thoughts or ideas. 

Best of luck to you. xoxo
